details: This package ships its entire implementation as obfuscated JavaScript: the main entry c-rc-3-cop3.js, cop3-rc-3-1.js and cp-3-rc-2.js contain large hex/unicode-escaped string arrays, escaped property names and rotating decoder functions, and build source strings at runtime that are executed through the Function constructor (c-rc-3-cop3.js around byte 18004, cop3-rc-3-1.js around byte 93470). The readable surface presents a didactic Colombian "crypto network" module backed by mysql2 and dotenv (module.exports = require('cp-3-rc-2') exposing initDB/run/get/all/transaction/dbConfig/testConnection/ensureTables), so the obfuscation conceals the module's actual data access and any destinations it contacts. The package declares no install/preinstall/postinstall lifecycle hook and no bin entry, and no network endpoint, credential-path access or token-harvesting string is visible in the deobfuscated literals; the only hosts in the package are documentation links in the README. There is no confirmed C2 IOC to publish for this version.
